query:
SELECT 
  pbq.id AS quote_id,
  pbq.repairer_name,
  pbq.quoted_amount_units,
  pbq.currency,
  pbq.source,
  COUNT(qli.id) AS line_item_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.line_total_units > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.line_total_units = 0 OR qli.line_total_units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_priced_items,
  GROUP_CONCAT(qli.description ORDER BY qli.id SEPARATOR ' | ') AS items
FROM panel_beater_quotes pbq
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.quote_id = pbq.id
WHERE pbq.claim_id = 6240003
GROUP BY pbq.id, pbq.repairer_name, pbq.quoted_amount_units, pbq.currency, pbq.source
ORDER BY pbq.id;
